rows.definition: The scorecard debt-integer key for the git-daily health card: the string "git_daily_debt" under which the card publishes its count of health lenses scoring below the pass line.
rows.distinction: Not the generic per-scorecard *_debt integer concept (x2-score-debt-debtintegers) and not a named scorecard surface (x2-score-debt-scorecardvariants): this is one concrete card's key constant, the argument the git-daily renderer passes to scorecard.Render to select which integer heads the work-list.

rows.definition: The one-call operator readout for the git-daily health card: it composes the graded card from HealthFacts and projects it through scorecard.Render as a terminal work-list keyed on HealthDebtKey.
rows.distinction: Not the generic scorecard markdown projector (x2-render-materialize-renderer), which it calls, and not a transcript renderer (x2-render-materialize-rendertext): this is the git-daily-specific compose-then-render pairing, the only entry point that decides WHICH debt key orders the readout.
